about: What the MEDS_extract-INSPIRE runner (INSPIRE_MEDS 291c948, MEDS-Extract 0.8.0) built from the synthetic release of tests/conftest.py with --no-enrich: each code's description and number of events. tests/test_runner_equivalence.py checks that meds-extract-run spec=INSPIRE still builds it.

ADMISSION_DEPARTMENT//CS.description: Surgical department for admission: Cardiothoracic surgery (INSPIRE operations.department 'CS', expanded by the release's department.csv)

ADMISSION_DEPARTMENT//GS.description: Surgical department for admission: General surgery (INSPIRE operations.department 'GS', expanded by the release's department.csv)

ANESTHESIA_TYPE//General.description: Anesthesia type: General (INSPIRE operations.antype: General, Neuraxial, Regional, or MAC = monitored anesthesia care)

ANESTHESIA_TYPE//Regional.description: Anesthesia type: Regional (INSPIRE operations.antype: General, Neuraxial, Regional, or MAC = monitored anesthesia care)

ASA//2.description: ASA physical status 2, mild systemic disease (INSPIRE operations.asa)

ASA//3.description: ASA physical status 3, severe systemic disease (INSPIRE operations.asa)

EMERGENCY_OPERATION//0.description: Emergency operation flag: 0 (INSPIRE operations.emop, binary indicator of an emergency operation)

EMERGENCY_OPERATION//1.description: Emergency operation flag: 1 (INSPIRE operations.emop, binary indicator of an emergency operation)

HEIGHT.description: Body height measured before the operation, cm (INSPIRE operations.height)

ICD10_PCS//02HV3.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 02HV3 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs)

ICD10_PCS//0DTJ4.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 0DTJ4 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs)

ICD10_PCS//5A195.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 5A195 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs)

ICD10_PCS//UNK.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): UNK (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs)

ICU_ADMISSION.description: ICU admission after surgery (INSPIRE operations.icuin_time); only ICU admissions within 24 hours of surgery are recorded

ICU_DISCHARGE.description: ICU discharge after surgery (INSPIRE operations.icuout_time); recorded only for ICU admissions within 24 hours of surgery

MEDICATION//B05XA03//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code B05XA03, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value)

MEDICATION//N02BE//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code N02BE, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value)

MEDICATION//N02BE01//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code N02BE01, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value)

MEDICATION//UNK//PO.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code UNK, route PO (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value)

MEDS_BIRTH.description: Birth (MEDS standard code); the date is estimated from the age at the patient's first admission, which INSPIRE reports in 5-year bins (operations.age)

MEDS_DEATH.description: Death (MEDS standard code); the earlier of the in-hospital and all-cause death times (operations.inhosp_death_time and allcause_death_time)

OPERATION_ID.description: Operation identifier, in text_value, recorded at the operation start (INSPIRE operations.op_id; a random number beginning with 4)

OR_IN.description: Patient entered the operating room (INSPIRE operations.orin_time)

OR_OUT.description: Patient left the operating room (INSPIRE operations.orout_time)

RACE//Asian.description: Race of the patient: Asian (INSPIRE operations.race)

SEX//F.description: Sex of the patient: F (INSPIRE operations.sex, M or F)

SEX//M.description: Sex of the patient: M (INSPIRE operations.sex, M or F)

VITALDB_CASE_ID.description: Identifier of the same case in the open VitalDB dataset, in text_value; a static (untimed) event (INSPIRE operations.case_id)

WEIGHT.description: Body weight measured before the operation, kg (INSPIRE operations.weight)
